items.excerpt: Google researchers built a reinforcement-learning system that lets a quantum computer learn from its own error-correction data and recalibrate itself mid-computation. The approach cut logical error rates about 20% beyond conventional calibration and stayed 3.5x more stable under hardware drift on the Willow processor, pointing toward autonomously self-tuning quantum machines.

Anthropic researchers built the "Jacobian lens" (J-lens) to probe inside Claude Opus 4.6, revealing a hidden "J-space" of words tied to the model's likely future outputs. It is one of the clearest glimpses yet at how a large language model internally anticipates what it will say next, advancing mechanistic interpretability.
